The '''WED-20''' was a survey/analysis droid from Cybot Galactica.

==Characteristics==
The WED-20 had 7 arms, which could be fitted with multiple different tools to aid in its job. It had tracked locomotion and was equipped with a video recorder to record its work. It cost 8300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.

==History==
The WED-20 was almost identical to the [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]], but it was designed and programmed for an entirely different purpose. It was used by scouts as a first-contact planetary-analysis droid. It would leave the ship and go out to collect samples of the local flora and soil and record images of the fauna. It would use the [[microlab]] in its base to perform analysis in the field.
